text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And here it is!
The final jewel of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho, is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this!
This thunderous roar filling the stands!
(Oooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... I-It feels as if it's
thrusting straight up from the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The dream of all those gathered here is, of course!
The Double Crown Umamusume—Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... w-what intense heat...!
This might be crazier than a live music venue...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Wait till you see the race, you'll be even more pumped!

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's... not good, is it?
Acting like you've completely forgotten about reality—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
No. Everyone... is trying to seize
something from the race.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: "It's not to forget. It's so that I can live on together with the pain—"

“—The roaring cheers pierce through all the way here.
In other words, the stage Orfevre desired—has been successfully set.”
choice_data_list: Now all that's left is to win.
Now all that's left is to win.

text_block_list.text:
I murmur to myself, suddenly realizing.
There is nothing left for me to do but pray.
My job as a Trainer ends here...
choice_data_list: (In that case, at least I can put my feelings into it...!)

text_block_list.text:
The gold pendant swayed against my chest.
As I unconsciously touched it... I suddenly realized Orfevre was staring at me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That which you have.
...It is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Did you wish for it?
And... for my victory?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――Shall I peer into...
the "possibilities"?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Speak your true thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do you
doubt me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Do you fret over possibilities
instead of awaiting an inevitable victory?

Orfevre is questioning my resolve...
asking if I feel the pressure.
If so, my answer is already clear—
choice_data_list: ...I am the staff that guides you.
...I am the staff that guides you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Which means?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so, it is good.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cast aside both prayers and wishes.
Simply wait for—your light.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There was one thing
I wanted to tell you, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...No, let's leave it.
For now, just stay like that... and think only of Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us bear witness.
To the coronation... of our dearest treasure.

There was an extraordinary tension in the paddock that day.
The appearance of a single Umamusume
completely transformed the atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...!!
Orfeeeeeeèvre!!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Victory! The flawless crown...!
—Grant the title of Triple Crown Umamusume to the King!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hear me, my people.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more.
Our inevitable victory shall be realized.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, right now,
swear it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"To give your newly crowned King—
a warm and fitting welcome!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is with this atmosphere...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, how could this happen...!
To be trampled underfoot by her like this forever...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't lose...! 
I... I will...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
We don't need an arrogant lead.
I'll drag them down!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I've grown tired of this.
—Shall we end it?
